title: Document project
summary: Generates or repairs managed DocInsight comments for every public declaration of the active project, started from the Structure form right-click menu
intro: Read this when a whole project needs documentation coverage. Right-click anywhere in the Structure form and choose Document project to generate or repair managed DocInsight comments for every public declaration of the active project (it runs document --project --apply).

surfaces.caption: Document project
steps: Open the Structure form (drag-lint > Show Structure)
Right-click a node in the tree
Choose Document project; managed DocInsight comments are generated or repaired for every public declaration the project owns

surfaces.usage: drag-lint document --qname <Foo.TBar.Baz> [--apply|--json|--no-backup|--migrate-pure] [--db PATH] - generate/repair a managed DocInsight comment

questions.ask: How do I document every public declaration of the project?
document --project warns or refuses because files it reads facts from changed since indexing -- what now?
